CC.settings.look.name: Container window look
CC.settings.look.hint: Your own choice; each player sets theirs. Chat card style is the module's original look (dark leather, gold rules). Base CoC7 sheet follows the standard investigator sheet: beige paper, green header, red titles. Themed sheet follows the Themed Sheets module.
CC.settings.theme.name: Container window theme
CC.settings.theme.hint: Automatic: follows your chat card theme. Otherwise forces a theme for this window (no effect with the base CoC7 sheet).
